thread:
Alex: Hey team — I need to swap my primary shift for next Tue night (2025-11-18 18:00-06:00 PT). Travel plans came up. Is Jamie available to take primary? I can take secondary instead.

Jamie: I might be able to, depends on load. What's the exact overlap window? Also any active incidents or releases then?

oncall-bot: Current on-call rota: 
- Primary: Alex (until 2025-11-18 06:00 PT)
- Secondary: Maria
Upcoming: Canary rollout scheduled 2025-11-18 19:00 PT (release-team).

Alex: Thanks bot. The shift I'm asking to swap is the 18:00-06:00 PT block on Tue night (my primary until 06:00). The only planned thing is the canary at 19:00 PT. No active incidents right now.

Jamie: I can cover primary 18:00-06:00 PT on Tue, but I have a calendar conflict 22:00-23:30 PT — can someone be available for escalations during that hour?

Sara: I can be reachable for that 22:00-23:30 window if Jamie covers primary otherwise. I'm remote but on-call-ready.

Leo: Heads-up — release team told me the canary has a small chance of increased 5xxs on initial ramp. Runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ONC/pages/Runbook+Canary+SLOs. If it spikes, follow step 2.b (scale pool + rollback if >1.5% errors for 5m).

Alex: Noted, Leo. Jamie — if you take primary, please run the pre-canary checklist at 18:30 (see snippet below).

```
# pre-canary quick checks
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep ServingPool
curl -I https://status.redwood.ai/health
check /ops/canary/checklist in confluence
```

Jamie: OK I can do the pre-canary checks. Sara — thanks for covering 22:00-23:30; can you be pinged via SMS if anything escalates?

Sara: Yep, SMS works. Number is in PagerDuty.

Maria: Quick question — does this swap require updating the rotation calendar and the PD escalation policy? I can update the calendar if everyone confirms.

oncall-bot: Reminder: to swap shifts, update the rota in `tools/oncall swap` or confirm in thread to let ops update.

Jamie: Let's confirm here: Jamie takes primary 18:00-06:00 PT Tue night. Alex will be secondary. Sara will provide backup for 22:00-23:30. Maria will update calendar and PD if needed.

Alex: Confirmed. Thanks all. I'll DM any travel contact details.

Maria: I'll update the Google calendar and PD schedule now. Tagging release team to note Jamie will be primary for the canary.

Maria: Done — calendar updated: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123 (changed primary to Jamie). PD rotation updated.

Leo: Thx. Jamie, if you see >0.5% 5xx in the first 10 minutes, escalate to release@redwood and call me.

Jamie: Will do. One more ask — can someone paste the emergency rollback command in this thread? Don't want to fumble it live.

Alex: Pasting rollback snippet: ```
# rollback canary
tools/release rollback --canary-id $CANARY_ID --reason "error-rate spike"
kubectl scale --replicas=0 deployment/canary-deploy -n inference
```

Sara: Got it. I'll stand by for 22:00.

oncall-bot: Action logged: shift-swap request by Alex -> Jamie. Ops update pending.

Maria: Ops updated PD and calendar. Leaving a note in the rota: "Jamie covers primary 2025-11-18 18:00-06:00 PT; Alex secondary; Sara backup 22:00-23:30."

Jamie: Thanks everyone. I'll take the handoff at 18:00 PT and post a check-in message once pre-canary checks are done. :thumbsup:

Alex: Appreciate it — handing over now.

Jamie: Pre-canary checks complete at 18:34 PT. All green.

oncall-bot: Handoff confirmed. Thread closed for swap bookkeeping.
